notes.title: Version 22.2.5.1804 released
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
[olist]
 the demand need not be fulfilled by player (it can be avoided by pushing pass button);
 "Show left cards after finished round" option is affected by "Preview of taken cards" option;
 replay: situation when bomb is thrown besides own turn is incorrectly saved.
[/olist]
AI:
[olist]
 bugfixes:
    * do not beat right/next opponent who just finished, partner will lead;
    * do not beat single of partner with strongest single, even if I would finish in next move.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 22.2.4.1793 released
notes.content:
Changes:
[olist]
 messages related to bomb preparation changed to be more clear;
 add space between buttons on bomb panel.
[/olist]
Bugfixes:
[olist]
 GUI: arrows on cards showing taken points are incorrect (spoiled with the fix "GUI: cards of left, top and right players are turned upside down ...").
[/olist]
AI:
[olist]
 bugfixes:
    * very long sequence should be played first, then Dog;
    * do not beat Ace of partner with Phoenix.
[/olist]
